review:
A detective mouse on a 6x6 tumbling cluster grid. Power Wilds land with levels from 1 to 10, help form clusters and stay sticky through tumbles until their level runs down.

Level Up symbols add one to three levels, keeping a wild alive longer. Three or more spyglass scatters give 10 to 18 free spins with Power Wilds still sticking. The levels make long tumble chains more likely. Up to 5,000x, 96.49% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
